proposition: Nafsat II, for Bāysunghur, was composed some five years after the events of 830/1427; MK's footnote puts it between about 832 and 835 (1429-32). MK's two statements of the interval do not coincide exactly (five years after 830 is about 835), so the date is an estimate.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing from exile to Bāysunghur b. Shāhrukh
